# BloodLink

> BloodLink is a voluntary, non-profit blood donation platform for Bangladesh.
> It connects blood donors with patients through smart matching, SOS alerts,
> real-time chat, and a verified donor network. Blood buying/selling is
> strictly prohibited — all donations are 100% voluntary and free.

## Website
- Homepage: https://bloodlink.tech
- Hospital Directory: https://bloodlink.tech/hospitals
- Blood Bank Directory: https://bloodlink.tech/blood-banks
- About: https://bloodlink.tech/about
- FAQ: https://bloodlink.tech/faq
- Download Android App: https://bloodlink.tech/download

## Public API
- Base: https://api.bloodlink.tech/api/v1
- Public stats: /config/stats
- Hospitals: /hospitals
- Blood banks: /blood-banks

## Key Facts
- Country: Bangladesh
- Cost: Free forever, non-profit
- Donation cooldown: 90 days between donations
- Donor eligibility: age 18-65
- Blood groups supported: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-
- Contact: support@bloodlink.tech
